caption:
Exhausted from pretending you're strong? God chose the weak on purpose. (Amos 7:14 devotional)

God delights to use not the strong, but the weak who stop hiding. His power is made perfect in weakness, not in your performance.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 What weakness am I hiding — sure that if it showed, I'd lose my place?
